question.text: An InvIT has publicly listed units and the financial year ended on March 31st. By when must the half-yearly valuation for the half-year ending September 30th be completed?

answer.text: Within 45 days of the end of the half year
Within 15 days of the end of the half year
Within two months of the end of the half year (by November 30th)
Within one month of the end of the half year (by October 31st)

explanation.text: The Logic: For publicly listed InvIT units, valuation has to be conducted every 6 months and completed within one month of the end of each half year. So for the half year ending September 30th, the valuation must be completed by October 31st. The Trap: Two months is the timeline for the full annual valuation from the end of the financial year (March 31st). The half-yearly valuation for listed units has the tighter one-month deadline. Note: Track two distinct timelines: full valuation is annual and due within 2 months from the financial-year end; the half-yearly valuation for publicly listed units is due within 1 month of each half-year end.
